description.zh: 过期时间（秒级时间戳，不能小于当前时间），同时设置Expiration和ExpirationTtl时，以ExpirationTtl为准。
description.en: The expiration time. This is a UNIX timestamp in seconds and cannot be earlier than the current time. If you set both Expiration and ExpirationTtl, ExpirationTtl takes precedence.

description.zh: 过期时间（相对时间，单位：秒），同时设置Expiration和ExpirationTtl时，以ExpirationTtl为准。
description.en: The expiration time. This is a relative time in seconds. If you set both Expiration and ExpirationTtl, ExpirationTtl takes precedence.

description.zh: 需要设置的Key名称，最长不超过512个字符，不能包含空格、反斜杠（/）。
description.en: The name of the key that you want to set. The key can be up to 512 characters in length and cannot contain spaces or backslashes (/).
The content of the key. The maximum size is 2 MB (2 × 1,000 × 1,000 bytes).

descriptions.en: > The call frequency is limited to 50 calls per second per user.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun dcdn put-dcdn-kv --namespace ns1 --key key1 --value value1 --expiration 1690081381 --expiration-ttl 3600 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun dcdn PutDcdnKv --region cn-hangzhou --ExpirationTtl 3600 --Value value1 --Expiration 1690081381 --Namespace ns1 --Key key1
